author: AlaskaYeen
quote:
My Personal Review: GTA 6 – The Biggest Letdown of 2026?
I actually took leave from work for this game. I made plans, rearranged my schedule, and organised everything so I could have an entire week off to enjoy GTA 6.
After years of waiting and all the hype surrounding this supposedly groundbreaking AAA title, I was ready for the experience of a **** after just 7–8 hours of gameplay, I found myself asking: WHAT THE ACTUAL **** IS THIS **** SIMULATOR 2026?!
My Ratings
Storyline: 2/10 – Boring, disappointing, and nowhere near what I expected from Rockstar.Graphics: 8/10 – Visually impressive, but graphics alone don't make a great game.Missions: 3/10 – Repetitive, underwhelming, and lacking the excitement GTA is known for.
What Happened to the GTA We Loved?Seriously, Rockstar, how do you take one of the biggest gaming franchises in history and turn it into something that feels more like a daily-life simulator?
I genuinely don't understand where these critics are getting their 90+/100 ratings from. From the community reactions I've seen, I'm clearly not the only one ****'s talk about some of the ridiculous gameplay decisions.
WHY DO I HAVE TO TAKE A SHOWER EVERY TIME I WAKE UP?!
What if I WANT to run around dirty? 
What if I don't feel like showering? Since when did GTA become a personal hygiene simulator?
And then there are the restrictions.Apparently, you can't shoot certain protesters or groups of NPCs. You can't shoot inside certain clubs. But somehow, shooting a furry is perfectly acceptable?
WHERE IS THE CONSISTENCY?!
GTA has always been about freedom, chaos, outrageous situations, and doing things in a fictional world that you would NEVER do in real life.That was the beauty of Grand Theft **** was an escape from ****, instead of escaping reality, I'm apparently expected to LIVE IT.Buying groceries? Fixing the house? Showering? Running errands?
ROCKSTAR, I ALREADY HAVE A REAL LIFE!I didn't spend money on a AAA game to come home from work and do MORE HOUSEWORK!
I understand that developers want to create a realistic, immersive world. But there is a massive difference between realism that enhances gameplay and realism that makes a game feel like a **** honestly feels like the developers have prioritised their own vision of everyday life over the chaotic freedom that made GTA **** 5 Understood Its Characters. What Happened Here?Let's compare this to GTA 5.
Michael, Franklin, and Trevor each had their own personalities, motivations, problems, and storylines.
Michael had his family drama and criminal past.
Franklin wanted to escape his circumstances and build something bigger.
Trevor was absolute chaos, unpredictable and completely unhinged. Every character brought something different to the **** that was BRILLIANT.
Now, in GTA 6, I feel like I'm spending half my time babysitting Lucia, taking care of her, and running ****. NO. AND ABSOLUTELY NO!
I wanted an exciting criminal storyline, unforgettable missions, unpredictable characters, and the freedom to create absolute mayhem.I did NOT sign up to become someone's personal assistant.
My Biggest Problem With GTA 6
It's not the graphics. Those are genuinely ****'s not even the ambition to make the world feel ****'s the fact that GTA seems to have forgotten what made GTA FUN in the first **** franchise was built on freedom, satire, controversy, ridiculous situations, memorable characters, and complete **** endless chores, unnecessary restrictions, and gameplay mechanics that feel like responsibilities rather than entertainment. If I wanted to shower, buy groceries, maintain a house, and run errands, I WOULD JUST GET UP AND GO TO WORK!
Final Verdict: 3/10GTA 6 might be a technical achievement, but for me, it's a massive disappointment in terms of entertainment.Beautiful graphics cannot compensate for boring missions, frustrating mechanics, and a storyline that fails to keep me interested.I waited years for this game.I took leave from work for this game.I rearranged my life to enjoy this **** after only a few hours, I was already questioning whether it was worth the wait.
ROCKSTAR, PLEASE REMEMBER WHO MADE THIS FRANCHISE SUCCESSFUL IN THE FIRST PLACE.
Listen to your community. Bring back the freedom, the chaos, the humour, and the unforgettable storytelling.
WE WANTED GRAND THEFT AUTO 6, NOT THE SIMS: CRIMINAL EDITION.
I'm not impressed. I'm not entertained. And I'm DEFINITELY NOT HAPPY.This is my personal opinion based on my first 7–8 hours of gameplay. Everyone is entitled to their own experience, but this is mine.

I typed everything out in a Word document and pasted it here, so I apologise if some of the sentences are a bit disorganised.
